content: Ketsutsi 'inɨari kemɨtiutawawiyarie
Merikɨtsɨ paritseutsixi meta tsarutseutsixi Ketsutsi 'aurie mekaniu'axɨani, me'i'inɨatakutɨ, 'inɨari mekanitawawirieni muyuawitsie mieme memixeiyakɨ.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: «Taikai, xeme mɨpaɨ xeputiyuane, 'uxa'a xɨari tsipɨreu'aneni, kamɨ haiwitɨri nixuxureni,
meta ximeri mɨpaɨ xeputiyuane, kename kawiye haiwitɨri 'aheutsuye. Xeme xepimate kemɨtiyuxexeiya haiwitɨri, peru xepɨkayɨwawe xemeitimani hikɨ kenemɨtiyuriene mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari 'inɨarieya kanihɨkɨtɨni.

Hikɨ miemete teɨteri 'axamemɨteyurie meta hipame memɨwakumaɨwa, 'inɨari mepɨkuwautɨwe memixeiyakɨ, peru 'inɨari mepɨkapitɨarieni, Kunatsi 'inɨarieya xeikɨa mekanipitɨariekuni». Hikɨ Ketsutsi waruku'eirieka kaneyani.
Tiyukuxanariyame paritseutsixi wahetsɨa mɨmieme
Merikɨte harakuna 'anutaɨye mekananukɨne, peru teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete paa memanu'ɨnikekai mekatenatɨmaiyakaitɨni.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarayehɨtɨani: —Yumarima 'aixɨa, xekeneyɨ'ɨwiyani tiyukuxanariyame paritseutsixi meta tsarutseutsixi wahetsɨa mieme hepaɨtsita.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniyutahɨawekaitɨni: «Paa temɨkaheye'ɨikɨ 'ayumieme mɨya kanaineni».
Ketsutsi retimaika kememɨteyɨtahɨawekai, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —¿Titayari niuki xetexɨatɨa paa tepɨkahexeiya xeteyɨkɨhɨawetɨ? 'Etsiwa kari yuri xepɨte'erie.
¿'Akuxi 'atsixekatehetimaiwawe? ¿Tamɨ xekatehe'eriwa 'auxɨwime payarikɨ yu'auxɨwime miriyari memɨte'ukwai, meta kepaɨmeme kiriwayari xemekuxeɨri?
¿Meta xekatehe'eriwa 'atahuta payarikɨ nauka miriyari memɨte'ukwai, meta kepaɨmeme kiriwayari xemekuxeɨri?
¿Titayari 'atsixekateheitimaitɨkɨka kename ne paa nekaxatakai? Tawarita mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe: Xekeneyukweriwayurieka tiyukuxanariyame paritseutsixi meta tsarutseutsixi wahetsɨa mieme hepaɨtsita.
'Anake yamekatenetimani kename memɨyɨ'ɨwiyanikɨ paa kuxanariyame hepaɨtsita kahainekai, matsi paritseutsixi meta tsarutseutsixi wa'ɨkitsika hepaɨtsita memɨyɨ'ɨwiyanikɨ pɨta hainekai.
Pekuru kemɨtiyutahekɨataxɨ

Merikɨte kepauka Ketsutsi Tsetsareya Piripu kwieyaritsie munua, yuhetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Teɨteri keme'utiyuane nehepaɨtsita, Yuri Tewi kenemɨtihɨkɨ? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya:
—Hipatɨ mɨpaɨ meputiyuane kename Wani Ti'ɨyame pehɨkɨ, hipatɨta kename 'Eriyaxi pehɨkɨ, meta hipatɨta kename Keremiyaxi pehɨkɨ, yatɨni kename xewitɨ Kakaɨyari niukameya pepɨhɨkɨ.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨta katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xemeta, ¿kexe'utiyuane kemɨ'ane nepɨyɨane ne?
Tsimuni Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Ekɨ Kɨritsitu pekanihɨkɨtɨni, Kakaɨyari mayeniere Nu'aya.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Aixɨa pepɨ'itɨarie 'ekɨ, Tsimuni Kunatsi pemɨnu'aya, tewi mɨmɨwe pɨkamatiutahekɨatɨa, matsi ne'ukiyari taheima makawe pɨta.
Netsɨ mɨpaɨ nekamatinahɨaweni 'ekɨ Pekuru
pekanihɨkɨtɨni, 'ikɨ tetetsie nepɨwatsutɨani memɨyutixexeɨriwani nehetsɨa miemete, meta mɨkɨ mepɨka'a'iwarieni tsepa memukwi'iwaxɨ.
Yawi nepɨmatsitɨkitɨani mɨreuyepiwa hakewa Kakaɨyari mɨre'aita, tita pemɨtihɨani kwiepa taheimata pehɨiyani, meta tita kwiepa pemɨtixɨna taheimata pexɨnarieni.
Hikɨ 'ana kaniwaruhɨritɨani teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete nixeime memɨkatehaxaxatɨwanikɨ kename mɨkɨ Kɨritsitu hɨkɨtɨkai.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiwarutaxatɨa kemɨtimierienikekai

Merikɨtsɨ 'ana Ketsutsi kanitsutɨani yuhetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mɨpaɨ tiwakuxaxatɨwatɨ: «Kaneuyeweka Kerutsareme nemɨmiekɨ, meta waɨkawa nemɨtikwinekɨ ta'ukiyarima meta mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete wahetsɨa, meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitamete wahetsɨa, mana nekanimieriemɨkɨ, matsi hairieka tukari nepanukukeni».
Hikɨ Pekuru yatewa heiwitɨka kanitsutɨani 'iku'imaiyatɨ, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Tixaɨ Ti'aitame. Mɨpaɨ pepɨka'itɨarieni.
Ketsutsi kwi 'enutaxeiyatɨ mɨpaɨ Pekuru katiniutahɨawe: —Xaɨtsie keneuye'a, Kauyumarie. Pepɨnetsikunuitɨamɨkɨ, Kakaɨyari hepaɨ pepɨkare'iyari, teɨteri wahepaɨ pɨta pepɨre'iyari.

Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yuhetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete: —Xɨka xewitɨ yuwaɨriyani tiyu'ɨkitɨwame nehetsɨa mieme mayani, ketihayewani kemɨtinake yuhetsiemieme tiyurienetɨ, yukuruxi ke'utitɨni, kenetsi'uweiyani.
Kemɨ'ane yutukari mɨwikweitsitɨamɨkɨ, kanitatɨmaiyamɨkɨ, peru kemɨ'ane yutukari mɨtatɨmaiya nehetsiemieme, kanikaxeiyamɨkɨ.
Tixaɨtɨ pɨkarayeika xɨka tewi kwiepa timieme naime ra'iwa, yaxeikɨa yutukari kanitatɨmaiyamɨkɨ. Nixewitɨ pɨkayɨwe mɨtiyutuani yutukari hetsiemieme.
Yuri Tewi kenemɨtihɨkɨ, nekaninuamɨkɨ ne'ukiyari hepaɨ nemariwetɨ neniuki tuayamete wahamatɨa, hikɨ 'ana nepɨtiwarakapitɨani, yuxexuitɨ kememɨte'uyuri.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, hipatɨ 'ena memu'uwa mepɨkakwini Yuri Tewi menetsixeiyameke neye'akaku nemɨra'aitatsie.
